summary.text: Mark Sigrist is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 10 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mark Sigrist was born in Columbus, Ohio, and earned a high school diploma from Grove City High School and a bachelor's degree from Ohio University in 1983.
Ballotpedia reports that he was retired as of 2024 and previously worked in management at Honda North America.
Sigrist assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2025, and serves on the House Ways and Means Committee.
He was unopposed in the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Denise D'Angelo Steele in the general election.
